disciplines.description: Use colors and brushstrokes to capture scenes, emotions, or imaginary subjects in unique visual compositions. Painting is about translating inspiration into layered textures and hues.

challenges.text: Paint a landscape or a view that you see at a golden hour.
Make an abstract painting listening to your favourite song of this week. What strokes and colors does it bring?
What's the most disguisting thing you have ever eaten? Paint it in a glorifying way.
Paint and object or an animal that doesn't exist.

disciplines.description: Use lines, shapes, and shading to bring ideas and moments to life with simple yet powerful strokes. Drawing captures essence and form in its purest, most immediate way.

challenges.text: Sketch a still life of your living room.
Capture a feeling of a live flower. It doesn't have to be realistic.
Draw a 1 or 2 page comic for your close friend. With you as characters.
Take an A4 piece of paper. Draw as if you were 5 years old again

disciplines.description: Craft stories, poems, and reflections that give voice to your thoughts and emotions, painting pictures with words. Writing is a way to share personal and fictional worlds through language.

challenges.text: Write a letter to a dear friend.
Find a headline in a newspaper and write a 2-page fictional story based on it.
Write a poem about an emotion you feel today.
Write about your day using as many adjectives as you can find.

disciplines.description: Capture meaningful moments and perspectives through the lens, using light and framing to tell visual stories. Photography freezes time and emotions in compelling images.

challenges.text: Photograph your most meaningful corner.
Take a black & white self portrait. Any props and experimental lighting are welcome.
Go outside and take a lot of quick photos in 15min. Pick one that's your favourite.
Take photo of something provocative.

disciplines.description: Express identity and creativity through fashion and design choices, blending colors, shapes, and textures to create unique personal statements. Styling transforms everyday wear into artful expression.

challenges.text: Style an outfit with 2 pieces you haven't worn in at least 6 months. Someting you forgot you had, the older the better.
Style a monochrome outfit. Only shades of the same color are allowed.
Dress up like someone you are attracted to.
Find a picture of yourself as a kid. Try to recreate shapes or colors of the outfit with something you would feel comfortable wearing today.

disciplines.description: Mold and shape clay or other materials into tangible forms that embody ideas, symbols, or lifelike representations. Sculpting gives physical presence to creativity in three dimensions.

challenges.text: Make a sculpture of a body part. It can be a part that you love or hate or don't care about. Large or small, but as realistic as possible.
Create a replica of your favourite furniture piece in clay.
Build a symbol for your current wish as a manifestation. Money? Love? New job? You decide. It can be abstract or realistic.
Make a candle holder that you'll be happy to use everyday.
